name: hotel-eda-prototype
description: Prototipo de arquitectura orientada a eventos para el área de eventos y banquetes de un hotel (basado en JW Marriott Quito)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n OPERA,EVENTOS,BLOQUES,COCINA,FOLIO,TABLERO -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white" "npm run start -w opera-adapter" "npm run start -w events-service" "npm run start -w room-block-service" "npm run start -w kitchen-service" "npm run start -w folio-service" "npm run start -w dashboard"
